crossRefs.note: Elon the Zebulunite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.
Then Joshua spoke to Yahweh in the day when Yahweh delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel. He said in…
Ben Deker, in Makaz, in Shaalbim, Beth Shemesh, and Elon Beth Hanan;

people.name: Aijalon
people.line: A Levitical city in Dan, site of Joshua's miracle.

people.name: Amorites
people.line: Canaanite people group, enemies of Israel

people.name: Beth-shemesh
people.line: City in Judah, associated with the Ark's return.

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

people.name: Shaalbim
people.line: Town in Dan, home of David's mighty men

translations.web: but the Amorites would dwell in Mount Heres, in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim. Yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became subject to forced labor.
translations.bsb: And the Amorites were determined to dwell in Mount Heres, Aijalon, and Shaalbim. But when the house of Joseph grew in strength, they pressed the Amorites into forced labor.
translations.kjv: But the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim: yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became tributaries.
translations.asv: but the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres, in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim: yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became subject to taskwork.
